# Ghost Swap

> Ghost Swap is a privacy terminal built on NEAR Intents. Private swaps from Solana are live. A dark pool on NEAR Confidential Intents is scheduled. Ghost Swap's own zero-knowledge pools are built and not deployed.

## Live
- Private swaps from Solana: Privacy swap on the NEAR Intents 1Click API with confidential handling, and a second partner route. https://ghostswapai.xyz/swap
- Privacy swap partner fee: 0.40% of the input, 0.20% to Ghost Swap and 0.20% to NEAR Intents 1Click, since October 4, 2026.
- $DARK holder payouts in wNEAR at 6 a.m. and 6 p.m. Pacific, from half of the 1% creator fee. https://rewards.ghostswapai.xyz
- ZEC-DARK liquidity pool on Meteora (Solana). Public trading liquidity, not the dark pool.

## Scheduled
- Dark pool on NEAR Confidential Intents. Target late October 2026, subject to NEAR enabling access. Confidential execution, not zero-knowledge. https://ghostswapai.xyz/docs/dark-pool

## Built, not deployed
- Zero-knowledge pools for Solana, Ethereum and Base. Local-development preview at https://ghostswapai.xyz/pool; not deployed on any public network. Development proving keys. Not audited. Do not deposit real funds.

## Not claimed
- Ghost Swap is built on NEAR Intents and is not endorsed by NEAR Foundation.
- ZEC in rewards and liquidity is a token on Solana, not native or shielded Zcash.
- Deposits and withdrawals are public. No fixed return.

## Documents
- Whitepaper v0.4: https://ghostswapai.xyz/docs/whitepaper
- Docs: https://ghostswapai.xyz/docs
- Rewards console: https://rewards.ghostswapai.xyz
